new bytes land in quarantine, unsafe bytes are not downloadable, authenticated scanner verdict gates promotion
consistent SQLite backup, AES-256-GCM objects, authenticated manifest, clean-target restore and integrity verification
inventory, retention policy, legal hold and erasure tombstone preserving digest lineage
request correlation, structured redacted logs and bounded process metrics
explicit HTTP timeouts plus bounded per-process token bucket
transactional reservation/settle/release prevents concurrent budget oversubscription in the current SQLite authority
enterprise boundary runtime check executes on supported Ubuntu/Windows matrix

globalDoD.definition: existing semantic and runtime release suites remain green
1,000,000 seeded boundary scenarios with zero false allows/denials
every workflow triggered for the final PR head is terminal success; skipped is not success
E3-E5 findings remain blocked until independent/deployment evidence exists
